credit_entry_source.name: credit_entry_source
credit_entry_source.value: ("credit_entry"."reason" in ('spent', 'released')) = ("credit_entry"."purchase_id" is not null) and ("credit_entry"."reason" = 'rainout_rebate') = ("credit_entry"."rebate_id" is not null) and ("credit_entry"."reason" = 'referral') = ("credit_entry"."referral_id" is not null)

season_rebate_numbers.name: season_rebate_numbers
season_rebate_numbers.value: "season_rebate"."games_count" > 0 and "season_rebate"."games_lost" between 1 and "season_rebate"."games_count" and "season_rebate"."paid_cents" >= 0 and "season_rebate"."rebate_cents" > 0 and "season_rebate"."rebate_cents" <= "season_rebate"."paid_cents"

suspension_games.name: suspension_games
suspension_games.value: ("suspension"."scope" = 'games') = ("suspension"."games" is not null) and ("suspension"."games" is null or "suspension"."games" between 1 and 20)

giveaway_donated_by_length.name: giveaway_donated_by_length
giveaway_donated_by_length.value: "giveaway"."donated_by" is null or char_length("giveaway"."donated_by") between 1 and 80

signup_challenge_winner_confirmed.name: signup_challenge_winner_confirmed
signup_challenge_winner_confirmed.value: "signup_challenge"."winner_team_season_id" is null or "signup_challenge"."confirmed_at" is not null

event_member_price.name: event_member_price
event_member_price.value: "event"."member_price_cents" is null or ("event"."ticket_price_cents" is not null and "event"."member_price_cents" <= "event"."ticket_price_cents" and ("event"."member_price_cents" = 0 or "event"."member_price_cents" >= 50))

event_ticket_purchase.name: event_ticket_purchase
event_ticket_purchase.value: "event_ticket"."status" in ('offered', 'released', 'cancelled') or ("event_ticket"."purchase_id" is not null and "event_ticket"."price_cents" is not null)

team_formation_request_text_lengths.name: team_formation_request_text_lengths
team_formation_request_text_lengths.value: char_length("team_formation_request"."proposed_name") between 1 and 40 and ("team_formation_request"."note" is null or char_length("team_formation_request"."note") <= 500) and ("team_formation_request"."decline_reason" is null or char_length("team_formation_request"."decline_reason") <= 500)

game_final_has_score.name: game_final_has_score
game_final_has_score.value: "game"."status" <> 'final' or ("game"."score_a" is not null and "game"."score_b" is not null and "game"."finalized_at" is not null)

game_forfeit_by_a_team.name: game_forfeit_by_a_team
game_forfeit_by_a_team.value: ("game"."status" = 'forfeit') = ("game"."forfeit_by" is not null) and ("game"."forfeit_by" is null or "game"."forfeit_by" in ("game"."team_a_id", "game"."team_b_id"))

team_keep_off_reason_length.name: team_keep_off_reason_length
team_keep_off_reason_length.value: "team_keep_off"."reason" is null or char_length("team_keep_off"."reason") between 1 and 300

merch_item_price.name: merch_item_price
merch_item_price.value: "merch_item"."price_cents" between 50 and 50000 and ("merch_item"."member_price_cents" is null or "merch_item"."member_price_cents" between 0 and "merch_item"."price_cents")

alert_setting_quiet_hours.name: alert_setting_quiet_hours
alert_setting_quiet_hours.value: ("alert_setting"."quiet_start_hour" is null and "alert_setting"."quiet_end_hour" is null) or ("alert_setting"."quiet_start_hour" between 0 and 23 and "alert_setting"."quiet_end_hour" between 0 and 23 and "alert_setting"."quiet_start_hour" <> "alert_setting"."quiet_end_hour")

announcement_text_lengths.name: announcement_text_lengths
announcement_text_lengths.value: char_length("announcement"."subject") between 1 and 120 and char_length("announcement"."body") between 1 and 5000

push_subscription_key_lengths.name: push_subscription_key_lengths
push_subscription_key_lengths.value: char_length("push_subscription"."p256dh") between 80 and 100 and char_length("push_subscription"."auth") between 16 and 32

permit_window_application_order.name: permit_window_application_order
permit_window_application_order.value: "permit_window"."application_closes_on" is null or "permit_window"."application_opens_on" is null or "permit_window"."application_closes_on" >= "permit_window"."application_opens_on"

team_constraint_has_date_or_time.name: team_constraint_has_date_or_time
team_constraint_has_date_or_time.value: "team_constraint"."on_date" is not null or "team_constraint"."time_index" is not null

season_fees_non_negative.name: season_fees_non_negative
season_fees_non_negative.value: coalesce("season"."team_fee_cents", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("season"."player_fee_cents", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("season"."free_agent_fee_cents", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("season"."early_bird_discount_cents", 0) >= 0

season_fee_matches_model.name: season_fee_matches_model
season_fee_matches_model.value: ("season"."fee_model" = 'per_team' and "season"."team_fee_cents" is not null) or ("season"."fee_model" = 'per_player' and "season"."player_fee_cents" is not null)

season_registration_window.name: season_registration_window
season_registration_window.value: "season"."registration_closes_at" is null or "season"."registration_opens_at" is null or "season"."registration_closes_at" > "season"."registration_opens_at"

social_post_hidden_not_shown.name: social_post_hidden_not_shown
social_post_hidden_not_shown.value: not ("social_post"."hidden" and ("social_post"."featured" or "social_post"."cover" is not null))

social_post_team_cover_has_team.name: social_post_team_cover_has_team
social_post_team_cover_has_team.value: "social_post"."cover" is distinct from 'team' or "social_post"."team_id" is not null

team_of_week_tab_needs_sponsor.name: team_of_week_tab_needs_sponsor
team_of_week_tab_needs_sponsor.value: "team_of_week"."tab_cents" is null or "team_of_week"."sponsor_id" is not null

roster_membership_dates_order.name: roster_membership_dates_order
roster_membership_dates_order.value: "roster_membership"."ended_at" is null or "roster_membership"."started_at" is null or "roster_membership"."ended_at" >= "roster_membership"."started_at"

waitlist_entry_offer_times.name: waitlist_entry_offer_times
waitlist_entry_offer_times.value: ("waitlist_entry"."offered_at" is null) = ("waitlist_entry"."offer_expires_at" is null) and ("waitlist_entry"."status" <> 'offered' or "waitlist_entry"."offer_expires_at" is not null)
